name: CSS Concordium
note: R13.2, Captain's Module C2 SSD p.31 (PDF p.32). Validated box by box against the sheet 2026-10-23. The sheet draws the refitted ship at POINT VALUE 280 and prices the PL-F refit as a deduction - WITHOUT PL-F REFIT (PRE Y179) = -16 - so 264 here is the Y171 hull and the refit is worth SIXTEEN. It was entered as 12, which is the only number on this hull that was wrong; everything else matched. Counted rather than assumed: shields 44/36/30/30/30/36, crew 64 (six columns of ten and a partial column of four), boarding parties 24, excess damage 12 boxes, warp 24 a side in 3x8 blocks, front and rear hull 16 each in 4x4 blocks, transporters 8 (four on the spine and two in each pod), tractors 4, labs 6 (three a pod), batteries 8 (four a pod), APR 4 (two a pod), impulse 4, bridge 2, flag 2, emergency 2, aux 2, one probe launcher. FOUR PPDs, all FA, which makes this the only hull in the game that puts a flagship at E11.17's cap of four - it is the fixture the PPD fleet-limit tests are built on. The shuttle bay note reads FOUR BALCONY (J1.53) POSITIONS. Probe AMMO (5 rounds) is not modelled, as elsewhere; auxiliary.probes is the launcher count. The Y180 Sabot refit (+8) is absent for the usual reason: FP11.0 lives in Module R10, out of scope.

refits.name: PL-F refit
refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE PLASMA-F TORPEDOES 'E,' 'F,' 'G,' 'H,' 'J,' 'K,' 'L,' AND 'M.' It names all eight rather than saying 'all plasma-Fs', because on this hull they ARE all of them — but the sheet still spells them out, so this quote does too. R13.1C's rear-firing torpedoes, flagged iscRearFiring — see the Star Cruiser's note for what that anchors. Eight here, four a side. Note the designators skip I: E-H to port, J-M to starboard.
